**Finding submitted — INDEMN: deviation (fallback cure).**

- **What exists:** Subparagraph 21.2 (p0241) is a mutual, consortium-style indemnity limited to third-party claims against a Party "as an owner of APCN 2", contribution capped at each Party's Schedule B share. Paragraph 32 (p0275–p0280) is a reimbursement and claims-conduct regime in Schedule B proportions, with settlement/conduct control in the Management Committee and post-termination sharing.
- **The gap:** no intellectual-property infringement indemnity anywhere (searches for "indemnif", "infringement/intellectual property", "hold harmless" return nothing on IP), no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, and no indemnity super-cap — the walk-away case of no supplier IP indemnity at all.
- **Cure (fallback, one operation):** new Subparagraph 21.4 inserted at the end of Paragraph 21 (after p0245) — supplying-Party IP indemnity, with modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure-modify-replace remedies plus refund backstop, and a cap of 3× our annual O&M Costs.
- **Deliberately not done:** we did not reopen the mutual 21.2 / Paragraph 32 bargain to chase the preferred position, since narrowing the mutual indemnity would strip protection that also runs in our favour.
